description: We are TBD, a small group of high school students.
summary: Our project is a game where you have to complete missions given by your comrades to make sure the space mission goes smoothly. It addresses the challenge by teaching kids the process of a space mission in a fun way.
details: It is a game where you move around the map, talk to NPCs, collect items, and complete missions. Our intended impact of this project is to make sure it teaches the basics of a space mission. We used Microsoft Paint for some of the drawings, Piskel for the assets and scenes on the game, and Scratch for the coding part.
